name: identity_permeation_stride
label: Permeation Stride
poeticVision: Imagine running through a dream, but every step you take makes your own form less real. You pass through a veil of shattered memory, and for a terrifying moment, your limbs feel distant, your steps less sure, your very body flickering at the edges of reality. The world seems to pass *through* you, and you through it, but at a cost: each permeable stride siphons away another anchor of who you are, making you lighter, emptier, more ghost than survivor.
usage: Attach this script to your player's CharacterBody3D node (e.g., 'Lyra'). Ensure the CharacterBody3D has a child CollisionShape3D with a CapsuleShape3D resource, and a child MeshInstance3D. The MeshInstance3D must have a ShaderMaterial applied to its mesh, using the 'permeation_stride_shader.gdshader' (provided separately) or a compatible shader that accepts a 'permeation_strength' uniform. Create Area3D nodes in your scene to define 'memory-permeation zones' and add them to the group specified by 'permeation_zone_group_name' (default: 'PermeationZone'). Lyra's collision layer/mask should be set to detect these Area3D nodes.

parameters.name: permeation_zone_group_name
parameters.description: The name of the group that Permeation Zone Area3D nodes belong to.

parameters.name: max_permeation_scale
parameters.description: The maximum percentage reduction in Lyra's collision shape size (e.g., 0.5 means 50% reduction).

parameters.name: permeation_speed_factor
parameters.description: A multiplier determining how quickly Lyra's permeation strength increases based on her movement speed within a zone.

parameters.name: permeation_recovery_speed
parameters.description: The speed at which permeation strength decreases when Lyra is not in a zone or is not moving.

parameters.name: permeation_identity_cost_rate
parameters.description: The rate at which Lyra loses identity per second when at maximum permeation strength.

verdict: A phantom's embrace of urgency, where every fading step etches deeper the cost of being.
impact: Permeation Stride will fundamentally alter player traversal and decision-making. It transforms movement from a simple act into a constant, agonizing negotiation with self-preservation. Players will feel the tangible cost of every shortcut, every desperate dash through a memory-zone, as their very identity flickers and fades. This mechanic will deepen the game's core theme of self-loss, making it a direct, moment-to-moment gameplay consequence, forcing players to constantly ask: 'Is this memory worth losing a piece of myself?' It will create moments of intense internal conflict, amplifying the game's unique blend of adrenaline and grief.
